_comment: High or critical npm advisories the audit check lets through. Each needs a reason and an expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD); past it, the check fails again so the exception is looked at. Owner decision 2026-11-17 for GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf.

exceptions.reason: No fixed version exists yet (every release up to 4.0.7 is affected). It reaches only build and test tools (vite, vitest, tinyglobby), never code shipped to users.
